title: Who gets power first
summary: When power is short, guns and the cryo bank are served first, mining last.
text:
When there isn't enough power for everything, the colony shares out what there is in a fixed order, most protected first:

- Turrets, other guns and Shield Projectors
- The cryo bank and drones, then homes (with their growth pods) and Med Bays
- The Radar, factories, Hydroponics, Repair Pads, relays and sensors
- Everything else: Mining Depots, Tech Labs, Deep-Core Mines and the rest
- Matter Printers, last of all

Mining Depots and Matter Printers never draw on the batteries: they only run on power being made right now. Turrets draw only a little while there's nothing to shoot, and full power while they fire.

A **brownout** is when even the top of the list goes short. Watch the ⚡ readout: red means the cryo bank is short right now. To get out of one, build more power, or **Switch off** buildings you can do without for a while (select one; its card has the switch).
